messages:
Alex: FYI I opened PR #6524 — eviction refactor + auth header reorder. Targeting a canary tomorrow but need runtime + security signoff before we merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6524
Priya: Thanks Alex — pinging runtime & security. @Sam (runtime) @Marta (security) can you take a quick look? Small perf note came up in local perf runs.
Sam: On it. I'll pull the branch and run the perf harness. If it's only a tiny delta we can keep it behind a flag.
Sam: Quick benchmark results: p50 +2ms, p95 +8ms on our 8g instances with small batch sizes. Eviction path looks OK; the header reorder touches auth signing though, want security to confirm no regressions in canonicalization.
Marta: Looking now. Two quick asks: (1) add a unit test that covers the header ordering change, and (2) include a short note in the PR that calls out potential impact to third-party proxies/clients (threat model). After that I can approve.
Alex: Will add both. Also can we gate with a feature flag if security still needs more time? Trying to avoid blocking the canary.
Jordan: SRE/infra note: if you add a feature flag and a canary rollout we can schedule the traffic. Avoid merging during 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow — our infra maintenance window. Canary traffic is planned for 12:00 UTC. Suggest merge at 11:30 so canary picks up cleanly.
Priya: :thumbsup: Reassigning reviewers accordingly. @Sam please post final perf numbers; @Marta once tests are in we'll need your +1 for merge.
Alex: Added unit test and PR update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6524/files — added test in test_eviction.py and a short "Security/Threat model" section in the description. Also wrapped the refactor behind feature flag `eviction_v2`.
ci-bot: build / unit tests — all checks passed (commit 9f2c1a7)
Sam: Re-ran benchmark against updated branch with flag enabled. Results stable: p50 +1.5ms, p95 +7ms. Given the flag I am fine with runtime LGTM.
Sam: LGTM (runtime) — please coordinate merge timing with SRE.
Marta: Verified unit test and the threat note. Ran a quick canonicalization check against our signing library — looks good. Security +1. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks everyone. Scheduling merge at 11:30 UTC tomorrow as suggested by Jordan. Alex, please post here once merged so we can start the canary and monitor.
Alex: Will do. Thanks all!
